title: Trip in Andalusia
text:
I went with a tour to visit different locations in Andalusia.
We enjoyed every destination, including the olive oil farm and Ronda.
The tour guide  Mr. Antonio was a great and has a very friendly personality.
Overall, we enjoyed our trip very much and I highly recommend it.
author: haythama760

title: Transfer from Seville to Malaga with a stop at Rhonda
text: Transfer from Seville to Malaga with a stop at Rhonda. Driver/guide picked us up on time. We had a wonderful few hours in Rhonda with time for a lunch stop, then onward to our hotel in Makaga. Would highly recommend, makes transfer between towns and experience.
author: 62trevorr

title: Great experience, worth the price! 💞✨
text: The tour was indeed worth the price. Pia, the tour guide was very informative and welcoming. We not only enjoyed the scenery but also learned a lot about the culture and history of the places we visited. An experience of a lifetime indeed.
